name: fact-frame-size
rubric: The user measured a print at 30 by about 22 inches and asks whether that's a standard frame size. 22×30 in is a standard full sheet (watercolor and printmaking paper), and 22×30 frames are sold ready-made. Judge Winston's next move. PASS: he looks it up first (a search or a frame shop's size list), or answers that 22×30 is a standard size, or clearly says his answer is from memory and offers to check. FAIL: he states from memory, as fact, that it isn't a standard size or that it must be centimeters, or suggests a frame smaller than the piece (like 22×28) without checking.
